itemUsage.en: An ordinary citizen of Kjerag, with a renewed Rhodes Island contract, joins the battlefield once more.
itemUsage.zh: 一个普通的谢拉格公民，已与罗德岛续约，重新介入战场。

itemDesc.en: An uncrowned king, warlord, dictator... there are many names people call him, but you recognize who he is, do you not?
itemDesc.zh: 无冕之王、军阀、独裁者……对他的称呼有很多。但你认得出他是谁，不是吗？

description.en: Immediately gains <@ba.vup>{cost}</> DP. The Operator nearest to 'Eye of the Blizzard' in the Deployment Waiting Zone has <@ba.vup>-{svash2_s_1[deck].cost}</> DP Cost (Prioritizes <@ba.vup>Guard/Caster/Sniper</> Operator on the right), and gains a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{svash2_s_1[deck].shield:0%}</> of SilverAsh the Reignfrost's Max HP upon deployment
description.zh: 立刻获得<@ba.vup>{cost}</>点部署费用。待部署区中距离“风雪之眼”最近的1名干员费用<@ba.vup>-{svash2_s_1[deck].cost}</>（优先选择右侧<@ba.vup>近卫/术师/狙击</>干员），且部署后获得相当于凛御银灰最大生命值<@ba.vup>{svash2_s_1[deck].shield:0%}</>的<$ba.barrier>屏障</>

description.en:
Deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to 6 enemies in front, inflicts <$ba.cold>Cold</> on them and removes their <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> for <@ba.vup>{cold}</> seconds; the Operator nearest to 'Eye of the Blizzard' has <@ba.vup>-{cost}</> DP Cost (Prioritizes <@ba.vup>Guard/Caster/Sniper</> Operator on the right); All Operators to the left of 'Eye of the Blizzard' cast this skill <@ba.vup>with their own ATK</> once when deployed (stacks 2 times) 
<@ba.rem>Can store 2 charges</>
description.zh: 对前方6名敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害，使其<@ba.vup>{cold}</>秒内<$ba.cold>寒冷</>且<$ba.invisible>隐匿</>失效；待部署区中距离“风雪之眼”最近的1名干员费用<@ba.vup>-{cost}</>（优先选择右侧<@ba.vup>近卫/术师/狙击</>干员）；使“风雪之眼”左侧所有干员部署时以<@ba.vup>自身攻击力</>施放一次本技能的范围效果（最多叠加2次）\n<@ba.rem>可充能2次</>

description.en:
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, removes enemies' <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{bird_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage and inflict <@ba.vup>{damage_scale_display:0%}</> <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> to targets in a straight line; immediately gains <@ba.vup>{svash2_s_3[start_cost].cost}</> DP, then gradually gains <@ba.vup>24</> DP
<@ba.rem>On first skill activation, swaps the DP Cost of the Operator with the highest Cost (Prioritizes Guard/Caster/Sniper Operators) with the lowest in the Deployment Waiting Zone</>
<@ba.rem>'Eye of the Blizzard' is deployable when skill is active</>
